title: Wall-slam E — Slayer Introspection, helm craft/components, Ring of slaying, Sirenic, Rex rings
purpose: Human/user rulings for the Slayer + sirenic + Rex-matriarch ring wall set. Info-only — does not edit catalog.
sourceReview: user wall-slam brief (2026-07-26): Slayer Introspection = kandarin+morytania+desert; Ring of slaying craft NO region req (primary misthalin); D2 full helm ladder unobtainable prefer pieces; Sirenic T90 forinthry+morytania / elite forinthry+tir
scraped-data/foreign-upgrades-user-rulings-applied-2026-07-26.json (D2 full helm remove; Introspection multi KEEP; Ring of slaying craft misthalin req=[])
scraped-data/fix-patches/wave2-walls.json (Sirenic T90/elite; Ring of slaying craft; helm craft/components/full ladder walls)
scripts/wall-slam-apply-high.mjs (merge schema: decisions[] action primary|keepHosts|remove|remove_all + confidence high|medium)
policy: Catalog is read-only in this pass — write decisions only.
Exact catalog upgrade names (must match u.name).
action primary: single home; requiredRegions defaults to [home] unless explicitly [] (Ring of slaying craft).
action keepHosts: intentional multi-host; requiredRegions = hard multi set.
action remove / remove_all: drop name from every host (D2 full ladder).
Do not invent Sirenic kandarin host — T90 is forinthry+morytania; elite is forinthry+tirannwn.
Rex rings (Stalker/Reaver/Channeller) share Anachronia heart + Fremennik base-ring dual; keep both hard.

decisions.name: Slayer Introspection (Amascut's Enchanted Gem)
decisions.reason: User: Slayer Introspection = kandarin+morytania+desert. Knowledge is Power / Amascut's Enchanted Gem multi dig-site hard gates (Stormguard/Warforge/Everlight style pressure); desert included per user multi set. Misthalin collector is not a host — do not expand hosts to misthalin.

decisions.name: Slayer helmet (craft unlock + base helm)
decisions.reason: Craft unlock + base helm homes on Morytania (black mask / practical helm assemble geography). Drop misthalin co-host. Point Learn is global; Smoking Kills desert points economy stays on its own desert row. D2: prefer pieces over full ladder — this is the base craft residual, not the unobtainable full upgrade mega-row.

decisions.name: Slayer helmet component farms
decisions.reason: D2: full helm ladder unobtainable — prefer component pieces. Keep multi farm hub: black mask Morytania, hexcrest Karamja, focus sight + spectral lens Desert, Misthalin ensoul/City of Um residual for necro lens path. All four are hard self-source pressure for full style coverage.

decisions.name: Full slayer helmet and point upgrades (reinforced through corrupted)
decisions.reason: D2: full helm ladder unobtainable — replace with obtainable pieces (craft unlock + base; component farms). Do not re-host the reinforced→corrupted point ladder as a multi-region upgrade.

decisions.name: Ring of slaying (craft unlock)
decisions.reason: User: Ring of slaying crafting has NO region req (could primary misthalin). Collapse off desert/morytania/fremennik hosts. Teleport destinations are logistics detail only — not requiredRegions. Empty requiredRegions is intentional (global points Learn).

decisions.name: Sirenic armour (T90 ranged power craft)
decisions.reason: User: Sirenic often T90 craft forinthry+morytania. Multi-ok those two only — do not re-add kandarin shop surface as hard host. Scales/thread are multi-source pressure inside forinthry+morytania framing; not a fake single-region lock.

decisions.name: Sirenic → elite sirenic armour
decisions.reason: User: elite forinthry+tir. Multi-ok forinthry+tirannwn only. Drop kandarin if it reappears. Not a clean single-region lock; do not invent all_required beyond this dual.

decisions.name: Stalker's ring
decisions.reason: Rex Matriarch heart (Anachronia) + archers' ring feedstock (Fremennik / DKs). True two-region self-source — both hard. Mirror Reaver/Channeller treatment.

decisions.name: Reaver's ring
decisions.reason: Same dual as Stalker/Channeller: Anachronia heart + Fremennik warrior/hybrid base ring. Both required for self-source.

decisions.name: Channeller's ring
decisions.reason: Same dual densify pattern: Anachronia heart + Fremennik seers' ring line. Do not invent ED-token acquisition paths.

notes: Sibling residual 'Slayer helmet craft + full upgrade chain' (single-host morytania in live catalog) is outside this own set — leave unless a later pass collapses it into craft+base or removes as D2 mega-row duplicate.
Ring of slaying (equipment residual) is not owned here; craft unlock is the wall. Do not re-emit multi tele dest as requiredRegions on craft.
Elite sirenic armour (T92 ranged power) single-host asgarnia residual is a separate thin row — not the 'Sirenic → elite sirenic armour' dual; do not merge names.
Apply via scripts/wall-slam-apply-high.mjs decisions merge (confidence high|medium only) or a dedicated rulings apply — not by hand-editing catalog in this pass.
